t: The New York Times Buys Wordle - The New York Times
s: February 1, 2022 - Wordle was acquired from its creator, Josh Wardle, a software engineer in Brooklyn, for a price “in the low seven figures,” The Times said.

Wordle was created by former Reddit engineer Josh Wardle for himself and his partner to play, before going viral worldwide in November 2021, leading the Times to buy it from Wardle in early 2022 for their Puzzles section.
